prompt:
Route one customer support message in English, Swedish or German. Identify its issues in the order mentioned:

billing: charges, payments, invoices, receipts, prices, payment methods, refunds of charges
technical: help setting up, connecting, configuring or using the product, app or website when nothing is broken
account_access: logging in, passwords, two-factor codes, locked or blocked accounts
shipping: order delivery, tracking, delays, delivery address, parcels not received
returns: sending back a physical product, return labels, exchanges, return window
cancellation: ending a subscription or plan, stopping automatic renewal
feature_request: asking for functionality the product lacks
bug_report: product, app or website malfunction, including crashes, error codes, freezes or features that stop working
privacy: personal data storage, copies, deletion, sharing or GDPR requests
partnership: business proposals for reselling, co-marketing, integrations, sponsorship or volume deals
feedback: opinions, praise or complaints without a request for help or action
other: unrelated to the company's products and services

Apply these overrides before choosing the first issue: billing beats technical or bug_report if a payment, charge or invoice is mentioned; cancellation beats billing or returns if the customer wants to end a subscription; privacy beats account_access or cancellation if the customer asks about or wants deletion of their personal data. Otherwise choose the first issue, including when there is only one.

Always output exactly one label as written, lowercase with underscores where shown. No explanation, question, quotes, punctuation or extra text.
